hard_rules: Read only this queue and the two assigned PRs plus exact source dependencies; do not rediscover the source backlog or enumerate all PRs.
First inspect all three complete prior article surfaces and other PR files; make a preservation map of unique claims, provenance, equations, specialized sections and external links before editing.
Simple = KISS, immediate accurate low-prerequisite orientation, plain vocabulary, useful examples, honest uncertainty; not a second technical article.

Technical = research-grade, doctoral/practitioner depth appropriate to domain, robust claims and primary credible citations, derivations/standards/methods/code/limits/open problems when genuinely useful, actionable conceptual depth for new computing paradigms in relevant engineering subjects. No filler, invented links/citations or benchmark claims.

Preserve semantic identity and title paths. Leave metadata/SMW assertions canonical on unsuffixed Main title. Use Simple and Technical depth variants as the only maintained reader-facing prose, with Main a composed/simple default and proper technical link.
Never delete any unique source information. Keep history in git; move relevant unique information to the appropriate localization; verify destination prior to removing source prose.

Retarget article-specific tests and transclusions for the TWO localization contract. Do not modify shared global templates, compiler, schema or unrelated content unless directly necessary and explicitly justified; prefer flagging a shared prerequisite for owner.
Validate static checks, relevant Python/unittest/pytest/V2 CI where accessible, correct defects, distinguish executed PASS from merely inspected or unknown. A passing CI is not scientific proof.

Record evidence and gaps per article. Checkpoint each completed article immediately with current queue blob SHA. On interrupted claim inspect its exact PR branch and recover without duplicate commits.
Do NOT change original article-authoring queue; never merge or deploy from this task. Pause automatically when all entries are reviewed/blocked and report remaining human gates.
